zero-extends `r8d` and jumps to `0080E310`, which splits `ecx` into a low 16-bit sum A and a high sum B and, for each byte at `rdx` (`r8` bytes), adds the byte to A and A to B: a length of 1 subtracts 0xFFF1 from A and from B when they reach it and combines them as `(B shl 16) OR A`; a null `rdx` returns 1; below 16 bytes it runs a byte loop, reduces A once and B modulo 0xFFF1 (multiply by `0x80078071`, shift 15) and returns `(B shl 16) OR A`; longer inputs run blocks of 0x15B0 bytes as 0x15B unrolled 16-byte steps with both sums reduced modulo 0xFFF1 after each block, then 16-byte steps and a byte loop over any rest with a final reduction, before the shared exit at `0080E5DB` (not shown in the listing); consistent with adler32 in zlib (modulus 0xFFF1 = 65521 and block 0x15B0 = 5552)
